name: artemis
description: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code.  It also achieves 99%+ success rate on AndroidWorld Benchmark.

capability_evidence.mobile-access: standard Python library into existing automated testing frameworks (e.g., pytest) or CI/CD pipelines with strongly typed Pydantic structured outputs and assertion support.
capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: or notes, no pre-execution safety net, no checkpoint verification or final report, and no ADB shell.
capability_evidence.mcp-support: Let AI assistants and test suites use real phones like a human.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Claude Code, Cline, Codex, Cursor

friction.note_en: Some setup. needs git clone (build from source); configure config.json/yaml/toml, sign-in required; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。需要 git clone (build from source)；需配置 config.json/yaml/toml、sign-in required；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: Cross-App Automation: Executes testing workflows and everyday tasks on Android from natural language instructions.
highlights: AndroidWorld Results: 99%+ task completion on Google Research's AndroidWorld benchmark (100+ multi-step tasks).
Flash Execution: A reactive observe-and-act loop with asynchronous history summaries, typically 3–5s per step.
